name: Joshua Reinberger
original_name: ヨシュア・ラインベルガー
source:
Affiliation: Elusion
Post: Pilot with the SG Squadron
Birthplace: Czech Republic (Prague)

An elite pilot with the SG (Strike Gunner) Squad who's very prideful.
He joined the crew of the Elusion to make his skills known to a wider audience.
